verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is an agent-skills and workflow package, so event-driven automation rules are a fair question for it. The evidence shows only explicit, user-invoked actions: CLI commands, ledger task management, and a Ralph loop that runs one explicitly assigned task. Automatic cycle detection is an adjacent built-in check, not a user-defined rule that fires actions on events, so nothing in the pack documents event-triggered automation.
